title: Kestrel and the Songbook
author: Gideon Fairweather
blurb: Freya Halloran, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
